Class SmartTagsComputer

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.doctor.history.SmartTagsComputer
public final class SmartTagsComputer extends Object
Computes New / Always-failing / Flaky / Regressed / Fixed smart tags from Allure history (issue #5975 / S3-09).

FR-001/FR-003: tags come only from history; insufficient history never invents Flaky. SC-001: passed then failed → Regressed. SC-002: first-seen failure → New (not Regressed). Duration-anomaly is optional when timings exist.
